title: Citizenship
pitch: A local-first, two-person study desk for the Canadian citizenship test.
description: Turns Discover Canada into 60-odd short sessions with quick checks, chapter tests and a timed mock exam, schedules misses for spaced review, and checks every question against a verbatim quote from the guide.

externals.name: Household sync
externals.seam: the household key a device joins with through #join=<key>; without one, useHouseholdSync in src/sync.ts never calls the Worker
externals.note: Progress stays in your browser. Sharing it between devices needs your own household Worker.
